title: Gidaar le magaalak qibnayti gufne
intro: Inki butta ummatta qigdu numma aaxige wayta magaalah albaabitte gufte. oson farmo baahen, takkay immay sigeenit naqboyti fan tendebbe, uluuluka meysissa. uxih, qammalsime wayte aracak, inki xongolo ugutteh kalaluh qibnaytiino, gudgud diraamah tekkooka milaaguh.
clues: Nanu ummatta kufrit radde magaala culle.
oson darem luk nee wagten kee iyyeenim, atu dubuk qaadik tan gino kinnito neh innah.
Nanu ken diggosneh, takkay immay oson xaa nel ugsen.
Inki num magaalak allal yan exxak ni numma diggoysuh yisissikeh.
usuk isi ummattah yiysixxigem macaay anu yoo gine num kah qibaada waam?
magaalak angodda gaba kalteh inki bakaq, kee tibba reeda inki adda oson yusuulen wak.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Caxaaxuwi arac qaran girat carareh suge
Kullumti num baddi afa fan gacse.

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
